claims.claim: monday.com sells four products with separate plan ladders: work management (Free, Basic, Standard, Pro, Enterprise), CRM (Basic through Ultimate), Dev and Service; Free exists only on work management.

claims.claim: Standard is the first tier with automations and integrations, and it allows 250 actions per month; Pro allows 25,000 and Enterprise up to 250,000.

claims.claim: The plan caps daily API calls: 1,000 per day on Standard, 10,000 on Pro and 25,000 on Enterprise, which binds a polling integration long before the complexity budget does.
